name: B10-0297/2025 (PPE) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Mali, where the military government has banned all political parties and jailed opposition figures. The Parliament condemns the ban and the crackdown, calls for elections soon, and asks for the release of people imprisoned after protests. It also criticises the Russian-backed Wagner Group for human rights abuses and says the European Union supports a democratic system with multiple parties in Mali.

- The Parliament takes a position; no law changes and no one is directly affected yet.
- It calls on Mali's military rulers to hold elections and free jailed protesters.
- It asks the European Union's representative for the Sahel to keep working on human rights there.
